items.claim: Unmounting any tools publisher clears the shortcut sheet
`'single'` paging misses a pointer already down when it turns on
items.note: Pointers are now tracked while paging is `'continuous'` too, through `useSyncExternalStore`, which returns `false` while off so continuous paging never re-renders. Reading `held.count()` on subscribe alone would not have caught a pointer pressed while no other reader held the shared tracker.

items.claim: A throwing `onSaved` drops the save queued behind it, leaves the slots cache open and leaves the rejection unhandled
A failed save drops its error, and logs nothing without `onSaved`
items.note: B's example does not happen as described: with `localStorage` blocked, `writeSlots` resolves `false`, because the storage layer catches the error and warns, so it never reaches the rejection handler. The handler still threw the error away whenever a save did reject. The test reaches it through a `RecordCache` that throws. `useSessionPersistence`'s `onSaved` doc is updated to match.
